verify_detail: detail routing, Back-stack navigation, Subscribe toggle, Tier dropdown UI (visually), quantity stepper clamping at a floor of 1, and idempotent re-application of the checkout discount.\n\nItems 1 and 2 are functional/data-integrity bugs (wrong price shown, wrong tier persisted) that directly contradict what the UI displays to the user — this is disqualifying for a release candidate.
